verdict.rationale: Appwrite has no dedicated sandbox or test-mode feature, but you can build an isolated test environment yourself. You can self-host a separate instance on any machine that runs Docker [14, 19], and point the CLI at it with the --endpoint flag [22]. Other pieces help: local Functions development [48], preview links for non-production Sites branches [51], migration between Cloud and self-hosted [43], and a community note that the containerized setup eases testing [comm-5]. Missing for 10: a first-class sandbox or test-mode environment, database branching or seeded test data isolated from production, documented guidance on staging workflows for agents (e.g. via MCP), and hands-on corroboration.
